110001 मतपत्रों की प्र ाजि हेतु सोमिार 16 माचा, 2026 11.00 पूिााह्न सम्मे लन कक्ष , कमरा सं. 112, प्र थम तल , िास्ट् त्री भिन, जिक्षा मंत्रालय , नई दिल्ली – 110001 मतों की गणना सोमिार 16 माचा, 2026 3.00 अपराह्न सम्मे लन कक्ष , कमरा सं. 112, प्र थम तल , िास्ट् त्री भिन, जिक्षा मंत्रालय , नई दिल्ली – 110001 पररणाम की घोषणा [फा. सं. 4-15/202022-टीएस.VI] जप्रयांक चतुिेिी, जनिााचन अजधकारी MINISTRY OF EDUCATION (Department of Higher Education) NOTIFICATION New Delhi, the 19th January, 2026 S.O. 266(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by Rule 8 of the Council of Architecture Rules, 1973, the undersigned, as the Returning Officer hereby fix the date, time and place for election of five members from amongst the Heads of Architectural Institutions in India to represent the Council of Architecture for a period of three years. The schedule for the election is as under:- TABLE Date Time Place Purpose 1 2 3 4 Tuesday, 10th February, 2026 Upto 4.00 p.m. Room No. 326-C wing, Ministry of Education, Shastri Bhawan, New Delhi- 110001 For the receipt of nomination papers and their scrutiny Friday, 13th February, 2026 4:00 p.m. Room No. 326-C wing, Ministry of Education, Shastri Bhawan, New Delhi- 110001 Information regarding valid nominations to all the candidates. Friday, 20th February, 2026 Upto 4.00 p.m. Room No. 326-C wing, Ministry of Education, Shastri Bhawan, New Delhi- 110001 For the withdrawal of nomination Friday, 27th February, 2026 Upto 5.30 p.m. Room No. 326-C wing, Ministry of Education, Shastri Bhawan, New Delhi- 110001 For the dispatch of voting papers to the electors Friday, 13th March, 2026 Upto 5.00 p.m. Room No. 326-C wing, Ministry of Education, Shastri Bhawan, New Delhi- 110001 For the receipt of voting papers. Monday, 16th March, 2026 11.00 a.m. Conference Hall, Room No. 112, 1st Floor, Shastri Bhavan, Ministry of Education, New Delhi – 110001. Counting of votes Monday, 16th March, 2026 3.00 p.m. Conference Hall, Room No. 112, 1st Floor, Shastri Bhavan, Ministry of Education, New Delhi – 110001. Declaration of Result. [F.
